name: BACH_0067
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 for invasive prediction [F1]; confirm stromal invasion before releasing drafted ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 98%, InSitu 2%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strongly favors invasive over in-situ |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 10% error rate (90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 64% OOD percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Typical image quality; flag clear |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (80%); 1 InSitu (BACH_0241, 88% similarity) [F5] | Mostly invasive; close in-situ neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 4, 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest driver (+1.21), above-typical score; AI spot check 19/20 [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 1, 11) · context · Above-typical infiltrate weighted against invasion (-0.95); spot check 8/20 [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low score pushes toward invasion (+0.39); failed spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Low benign stroma pushes toward invasion (+0.26); spot check 20/20 · Validated
- **HoVer-Net neoplastic nuclei** (region 6) · context · 86 neoplastic cells (1872/mm², 87th percentile); nuclear area CV 83rd percentile · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random removal (95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); case leans on unreliable normal_lobules, necrosis, and mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- Duct-confined atypia mimics invasion, as in neighbor BACH_0241 (InSitu, 88% similarity), which differs most in duct_confined and normal_lobules.
- Unreliable positive concepts (normal_lobules +0.39, necrosis +0.21, mitoses +0.19) inflate the invasive score without true stromal breach.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5, 8, 10**: Verify true stromal invasion in highest-risk regions (97%–100% risk) before ordering ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67.
2. **Region 6**: Inspect duct borders around 86 measured neoplastic nuclei (1872/mm²) to rule out in-situ carcinoma.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 11**: Check whether dense TILs obscure intact basement membranes or entrapped lobules.

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names Invasive, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
